item.title: NRM Releases Roadmap for EALA By-Elections to Fill Two Vacant Seats
item.description: The ruling National Resistance Movement (NRM) has unveiled the official roadmap for by-elections to fill two vacant seats in the 5th East African Legislative Assembly (EALA).
